component-metadata.author: knimeuser
component-metadata.description:
Metanode for FASTA files conversion to tabular format.
Single table is the metanode output with sequence header in its 1st column and seqeunce without spaces in the second column. You can specify the names of the header and sequence columns.
There is currently limitation in size of the database related to the RAM usage.
